basis: Unmodified Data::XDI::xdi_make_clone and actual Xray::XDI reader, Moose deep clone, and serializer. Only group xdi/bkg_z/fft_edge accessors are bridged. Cu/Fe measured tables retain every observation; scan times, prior process and special-character metadata are controlled probe inputs.
determinism: PERL_HASH_SEED=0 and PERL_PERTURB_KEYS=0 stabilize native Moose attribute traversal and Data::Dumper order. Other hash seeds can cause native file-trigger rereads and metadata loss. The web preserves captured metadata without rereading the source path.
boundary: Positive timestamp removal is a primitive probe, not an assertion that a particular Athena UI operation uses it. Sum and other web-only processing descriptions are not exact native caller assertions. No desktop GUI lifecycle replay.
